docs.title: Billing disputes and chargebacks
docs.heading: Steps
docs.text:
Billing disputes and chargebacks > Steps

1. Open the dispute ticket in the helpdesk and locate the invoice number (format INV-YYYYMM-NNNNN) and charge date.
2. In the admin console, search for the workspace by billing email or invoice number.
3. Verify that the person who opened the dispute is the Owner or an Admin of the workspace. Support discusses billing details only with the Owner or Admins of the workspace that was charged, and never shares information about another customer's workspace. If the requester is not authorized, reply with macro BILLING_AUTH_REQUIRED and close the ticket.
4. Check the charge history for the workspace. If the same card was charged the same amount twice within 24 hours, the second charge is a duplicate; after review, the billing team reverses it within 5 business days. Tag the case as Duplicate Charge and assign it to the billing team immediately.
5. If the charge is not a duplicate, check whether the dispute was filed within 14 days of the charge. Refunds are only possible within 14 days of a charge. If the dispute is outside this window, note "Outside refund window" in the internal case log.
6. Document the workspace activity in the case: number of active members, last sign-in date, number of pages and tasks created in the billing cycle, and whether the workspace is still active or has been deleted.
7. Check for prior disputes or refunds on the same workspace. If this is a repeat dispute, note the earlier case numbers and escalate to the billing team with priority High.
8. Assign the case to the billing team queue and add the tag Chargeback if the bank initiated the dispute, or Refund Request if the customer contacted Quillstack first.

docs.title: I was charged twice: duplicate charges
docs.heading: Steps
docs.text:
I was charged twice: duplicate charges > Steps

1. Go to Settings > Billing > Invoices and find the invoice numbers for both charges.
2. Compare the invoice dates, amounts, and line items.
3. If the invoices are identical and both were issued within 24 hours, contact support from Settings > Support.
4. Include both invoice numbers (formatted INV-YYYYMM-NNNNN) and a screenshot of your bank statement showing both charges.
5. The billing team reviews the request and replies within 3 business days.

If the same card is charged the same amount twice within 24 hours, the second charge is a duplicate; after review, the billing team reverses it within 5 business days. Refunds are never issued automatically or by the support assistant; every refund request is reviewed by the billing team, which replies within 3 business days. Once the reversal is processed, the charge disappears from your statement or appears as a credit, depending on your bank's policies.

docs.title: Refund approval policy
docs.heading: Duplicate charges
docs.text:
Refund approval policy > Duplicate charges

If the same card was charged the same amount twice within 24 hours, treat it as a duplicate. Check the transaction log in the admin console: if both charges have status `succeeded` and timestamps less than 24 hours apart, reverse the second charge within 5 business days. Tag the transaction with `duplicate_reversed` and reply with macro REFUND_DUPLICATE_APPROVED. No further approval is needed.

docs.title: Refund approval policy
docs.heading: Decision tree
docs.text:
Refund approval policy > Decision tree

Use this table to decide whether to approve:

| Scenario | Refund? | Action |
|----------|---------|--------|
| Duplicate charge (same card, same amount, within 24 hours) | Yes | Reverse the duplicate within 5 business days; log as duplicate in admin console |
| Request within 14 days, first refund for this workspace | Yes | Full refund; note in workspace record |
| Request within 14 days, second or later refund for same workspace | Escalate | Forward to #billing-escalations for approval |
| Request after 14 days | No | Offer credit or proration; cite refund window |
| Customer removed seats mid-cycle | No | Explain credit will apply to next invoice; removed seats are never refunded in cash |
| Failed payment triggered read-only mode, now resolved | No | No refund; access was restored when payment succeeded |
| Customer claims they did not authorize the charge | Escalate | Forward to #billing-disputes and cc legal@ |

docs.title: Refund policy
docs.text:
Refund policy

Quillstack issues refunds for charges made in error or when you are not satisfied with the service, but refunds are only available for a limited time after the charge. This policy applies to all plans and billing frequencies.

docs.title: Refund policy
docs.heading: Troubleshooting
docs.text:
Refund policy > Troubleshooting

days you used the service. The billing team's reply email explains the calculation. If the refund amount does not match the explanation, reply to the email and ask for clarification.

**I canceled within 14 days but was told I do not qualify for a refund.** The 14-day window applies to individual charges, not to the entire subscription. If you used the service for the full billing period and then canceled, no refund is issued because you received the service you paid for. Refunds are only issued if you cancel partway through a billing period and request a prorated refund for the unused time.

**Can I get a refund for a charge from last year?** No. Refunds are only possible within 14 days of the charge. After 14 days, the charge is final. If you believe you were charged in error, contact the billing team with your invoice number and they will investigate, but refunds are not guaranteed for old charges.

docs.title: Refund approval policy
docs.heading: Escalations
docs.text:
Refund approval policy > Escalations

Escalate to #billing-escalations if the customer has already received one refund in the past 12 months, if they are disputing the charge as unauthorized, or if the situation does not match any row in the decision tree. Include the workspace ID, charge ID, request date, and your recommendation. The billing lead replies within 1 business day.
